messages:
Zoe (CS): Dropping a tiny 'Warmchain' handoff for renewal-risk customers. Goal: stagger prewarm, limit retries, capture telemetry, and provide a deterministic degrade.
Cam (FieldOps): Need copy/paste runbook steps our infra team can execute during the maintenance window.
Zoe (CS): Short plan below (paste into customer runbook). Three phases + on-call checklist.
Phase 1 - Prewarm (T-30m): run 4 distinct prewarm calls to prime KV/cache for top routes. Example: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Warmchain seed","max_tokens":20,"mode":"prewarm"}'
```
Phase 2 - Staggered Ramp (T0-T+60m): apply conservative config and step traffic 10%->30%->60%->100% with 8min watches. Safe config snippet: 
```
{ "prewarm": true, "prewarm_ttl_sec":300, "max_prewarm_concurrency":3, "batch_window_ms":30, "stream_abort_ms":800, "circuit_breaker_pct":0.07 }
```
Phase 3 - Stabilize & Capture (T+1h to 48h): keep prewarm TTL for 24h, collect one slow trace and one failed exemplar every 12h, tag with `cs:warmchain:<acct>`. If error_rate >= 6% or p95 > 800ms: execute fallback.
Fallback (instant): set `prewarm=false`, set `batch_window_ms=120`, route to `fallback_model:quant-small-v1` for 90s, enqueue inputs for async processing, open incident `warmchain-fallback-<acct>`.
Ravi (SRE): Add probe endpoint for field teams (off by default): GET /v0/health/warmchain -> {"status":"ok","last_prewarm":"iso-ts","cache_hits":N}. Also recommend `prefetch_backoff_ms:200`.
Maddie (Solutions): For enablement calls, provide a 12-prompt pack (8 happy, 3 edge, 1 adversarial). Ask customers to run the 4 prewarm calls with their top 4 prompts and attach any low-quality outputs.
TraceBot: REMINDER: tag traces with `cs:warmchain` and add `priority:renewal` for any fallback.
Zoe (CS): On-call checklist (copyable):
- T-30m: run 4 prewarm curl commands
- Apply safe config before traffic shift
- Step ramp with 8min observation windows
- If errors: run fallback, collect traces, notify customer
Cam (FieldOps): This is actionable. I'll run Day0 per the checklist and report back. Zoe, please post the 1-pager to the onboarding-kit channel.
Zoe (CS): Will do by EOD PST. Closing thread.
